source.citation: Jucá dos Santos, Felipe et al. (2026). Hive Monitoring (Apis mellifera and Stingless Bees) and Rainfall Data - Federal University of Ceará (UFC) Apiary - Brazil. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20399470

timestamp_policy.source_timezone: unknown; timestamps contain no offset or timezone identifier
timestamp_policy.assumption: An offset of +00:00 is attached for deterministic bookkeeping only. This is not evidence that the source timestamps were recorded in UTC or a claim about their actual local timezone. No clock-time conversion was performed.
timestamp_policy.aggregation: Left-closed hourly windows [h,h+1), labeled by h+1 (hour end). All feature values become available only at this hour-end timestamp.

selection.method: Select the longest sequence of exactly adjacent occupied hourly bins after filtering the complete Apis2 raw file. Ties would choose the earliest segment. Selection uses observation availability, not forecast scores.

raw_filter: finite external temperature and -50 <= ext_temperature <= 60 degrees C
exclude a raw row when ext_temperature == 0 and ext_humidity == 0

aggregation.weight_kg: median(weight) over valid samples per hour
aggregation.temperature_c: median(ext_temperature) over the same valid samples per hour
aggregation.hive_id: ufc_apis_2; maps source file dadosColmeia2Apis.csv, id_sensor 3

transforms.imputation: none; no interpolation, forward fill, backfill, or synthetic observations
transforms.event_policy: colony_alert if absolute change from previous selected hourly median weight > 1 kg; normal otherwise. These are derived operational rule labels, not source event annotations or diagnoses.

alerts.basis: derived absolute adjacent hourly-median change > 1 kg; cause unknown
derived absolute adjacent hourly-median change > 1 kg; cause unknown
derived absolute adjacent hourly-median change > 1 kg; cause unknown
derived absolute adjacent hourly-median change > 1 kg; cause unknown

limitations: Only one hive and approximately one month are retained; not evidence of generalization to other sites, species, seasons, or production workloads.
The source has no event labels establishing the cause of abrupt weight changes. Harvesting, equipment intervention, sensor issues, and colony events cannot be distinguished from these measurements.
normal means only that the greater-than-1-kg numeric rule did not fire; it does not establish biological health.
Temperature means external ambient temperature, not internal hive temperature.
Each occupied hour can contain as few as one valid raw sample; hourly medians have variable sample support.
The segment-selection step was performed on all timestamps for data availability. Keep model fitting, scaling, threshold tuning and performance evaluation chronological within the retained segment.
The final source span may contain incomplete hourly coverage; no such extension or filling was applied.
